display_long_description:
# Find, aim, shoot — be a hunter. Join the hunt!

Enjoy this open-world hunting game. Hunting Simulator isn’t just a classic deer hunting game or another wild hunt. This game was created by a real hunter and sniper enthusiast.

**Deer, buck, elk, moose, bear, wild boar, wolf, fox**, and **hare** are all represented here. Try to find them all. Be patient — some animals are hard to spot in thick grass and brush. 
[media]
You may not encounter them all on your first hunt. But rest assured — they are here, just hiding.

Landing your first shot may be challenging, but don’t give up — keep practicing.

- Use **different Hunting Rifles and Shotguns** with scopes to earn your trophies.

- Use **Digital Binoculars with thermal vision** if you want to see your target more clearly. The game also features a **night hunting mode**. Thermal vision is especially effective in the dark.
[media]
Be careful — some animals are dangerous and may attack you. If they don’t attack, you got lucky. In any case, you can always try your luck with a **Hunting Pro Knife** in your hands.
[media]
Please keep in mind that we continue to develop the game and plan to further improve its hunting world.

An update is coming! Get ready to compete.
